responsibility: Lexes Rust source text into validated tokens and nested token trees for the parser, combining the main string-reading entry points in `mod.rs` with token-tree construction and delimiter recovery in `tokentrees.rs`, literal escape diagnostic translation in `unescape_error_reporting.rs`, and unicode confusable detection and replacement guidance in `unicode_chars.rs` so that raw source is normalized, linted, and recovered into parser-ready token streams.
